Faction.name: {=gwp_clan_name}Grey Wardens
Faction.text: {=gwp_clan_description}The Grey Wardens trace their charge to the constabulary of the old, undivided Empire. When the Empire broke apart, this sisterhood of lawkeepers did not perish with the former order. Blood, rule, and the lawful tradition of the old Empire bound them together. They ride the roads, seize malefactors, settle private feuds, and leave a road back to lawful conduct for those willing to atone. To many common folk, the Grey Wardens are less a noble house than a secular order of grey-robed sisters sworn to keep the peace.
